_provenance.note: Georgia citation authorities. The DFCS SNAP Policy Manual is cited by section number ('SNAP Manual §3355'); amendments issue as numbered Manual Transmittals ('MT-87') with public cover-letter PDFs at pamms.dhs.ga.gov/dfcs/snap/_attachments/. Forms (297/297A/508/528/298/339/507/858/859/841/47/296) are referenced in prose, not extracted as citations. Every manual section carries a header with Effective Date + MT lineage — the best-versioned source in the roster so far.
